_comment: Every address here was read off the chain with eth_call / eth_getCode, not copied from documentation. Two things the docs get wrong: the testnet chain id (they say 195; the live RPC answers 1952, and 195 is deprecated with an empty RPC list), and the stack — X Layer migrated from Polygon CDK to the OP Stack in December 2025. Verified 2026-08-30.

USDT0._note: The symbol contains U+20AE (₮), not an ASCII T. String-matching on "USDT0" will not find this token.

assets._usdcNote: Two contracts on X Layer both report symbol() == "USDC". The native Circle one and the bridged USDC.e. Pick deliberately.

chainlink._equityNote: There is no equity push feed on X Layer. All 26 X Layer push feeds are crypto. Equity prices exist only as Chainlink Data Streams, which is a paid subscription and whose on-chain StreamsLookup pattern is NOT supported on X Layer. That is why StockPriceOracle takes a relayed print with its source and timestamp recorded on chain, rather than pretending to read a feed that does not exist.

testnet.name: X Layer Testnet
testnet._chainIdNote: Official docs say 195. The live RPC returns 0x7a0 = 1952. The old X1 testnet on 195 no longer answers.

faucet._note: GeeTest v4 slider CAPTCHA plus OKX device fingerprinting. No account or wallet connection needed — an address is pasted in — but the CAPTCHA cannot be automated. 0.2 OKB is ~2400x the cost of a full Polaris deployment.

assets._note: USDT0 is not deployed on X Layer testnet. eth_getCode returns 0x for both the token and the OFT. Polaris deploys a labelled stand-in there instead.

stack.proofSystem: ZK validity proofs (OP Succinct / SP1), respectedGameType 42. Cannon FaultDisputeGame is not deployed.

standardBridge._note: The OP standard bridge is deliberately disabled on X Layer: depositETH, bridgeETH, depositERC20 and a plain ETH transfer all revert with the string 'not allow bridge'. Do not design a flow that assumes users can bridge in through it.

stack._lendingImplication: Being an L2 with a single sequencer is the material fact for a lending protocol: if the sequencer stalls, borrowers cannot reach the chain to repay while prices keep moving, and every position becomes liquidatable the moment it resumes. PolarisEngine reads Chainlink's L2 Sequencer Uptime feed and refuses to liquidate during an outage and for a grace period after recovery.
